Omoikane AI connects to your local Laravel API server for chat, agent, and data features.
Omoikane AI uses the microphone to convert your speech into text for chat messages. Your voice data is processed on-device and is not stored.
Omoikane AI uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice into chat messages in real time.
Omoikane AI needs access to folders for Agent Mode — to read, create, edit, and delete files as instructed by you.
Omoikane AI needs access to folders for Agent Mode file operations.
Omoikane AI accesses files in your selected workspace for Agent Mode operations: indexing, reading, creating, modifying, and deleting files.
